title: Threatens to cut your electricity tonight
why: Power companies do not cut supply at 9:30 tonight because of a text message. The number in the message connects you to a fraudster.
examples: Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm because previous month bill was not updated. Call 9876543210.
Bijli bill unpaid, connection will be cut tonight. Contact officer now.
safe: Electricity bill of Rs 840 generated for October. Due date 12 Nov.
Your power supply has been restored.
